# Tapir commands: Teamwork Commands

The 18 commands of this group, with their parameters, results and examples. Every group and how a command is sent: [commands.md](https://archicad-api.com/commands.md).

## Teamwork Commands

### TeamworkSend

Performs a send operation on the currently opened Teamwork project.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 0.1.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#TeamworkSend

Parameters: none.


Grasshopper: `TeamworkSendComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/TeamworkSend.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/TeamworkSend.py): Sends your changes to the BIMcloud server with TeamworkSend. Needs an open Teamwork project.

### TeamworkReceive

Performs a receive operation on the currently opened Teamwork project.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 0.1.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#TeamworkReceive

Parameters: none.


Grasshopper: `TeamworkComponents`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/TeamworkReceive.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/TeamworkReceive.py): Receives the changes of the other team members from the BIMcloud server with TeamworkReceive. Needs an open Teamwork project.

### GetTeamworkProjectInfo

Tells whether the opened project is a Teamwork project and whether it is online, and returns its BIMcloud server, project name and the current user (id and name).

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetTeamworkProjectInfo

Parameters: none.

Returns:

- `isTeamwork` (boolean, required): True, if the opened project is a Teamwork (BIMcloud) project. When false, every other Teamwork field is left out.
- `isOnline` (boolean, required): True, if the Teamwork project is connected to its BIMcloud server. False in a solo project or when the Teamwork project works offline.
- `userId` (number): The Teamwork user identifier of the current user, as the Teamwork commands report users.
- `userName` (string): The name of the current Teamwork user.
- `serverUrl` (string): The address of the BIMcloud server of the Teamwork project.
- `projectName` (string): The name of the Teamwork project on the server.

Grasshopper: `GetTeamworkProjectInfoComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetTeamworkProjectInfo.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetTeamworkProjectInfo.py): Tells with GetTeamworkProjectInfo whether the open project is a Teamwork project, and its server, project name and current user.

### ReserveElements

Reserves elements in Teamwork mode. GUIDs that are not elements (navigator items, layouts, databases) cannot be reserved with it: they are returned in notElements and the execution result fails.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 1.1.4. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ReserveElements

Parameters:

- `elements` (Elements, required)

Returns:

- `executionResult` (ExecutionResult, required)
- `notElements` (array of ElementIdArrayItem): The given GUIDs that are not elements, e.g. navigator items, layouts or databases. They were not reserved, and executionResult fails because of them even if the other elements were reserved. Left out when every GUID is an element.
- `conflicts` (array of object)
  - `elementId` (ElementId, required)
  - `user` (User, required)

Grasshopper: `ReserveElementsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/ReserveElements.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/ReserveElements.py): Reserves the first wall of the project with ReserveElements and prints the users who hold it if that fails. Needs an open Teamwork project with at least one Wall. A wall that was free before is released again at the end.

### ReleaseElements

Releases elements in Teamwork mode. Fails, naming them, when any of the given GUIDs is not an element; the other elements are released.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 1.1.4. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ReleaseElements

Parameters:

- `elements` (Elements, required)


Grasshopper: `ReleaseElementsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/ReleaseElements.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/ReleaseElements.py): Reserves the first wall of the project and releases it again with ReleaseElements. Needs an open Teamwork project with at least one Wall.

### GetReservationStatusOfElements

Returns the Teamwork reservation status of elements without reserving them: whether each element is free, reserved by the current user or reserved by another user, with the reserving user. New elements stay reserved by the user who created them until they are released.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.3. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetReservationStatusOfElements

Parameters:

- `elements` (Elements, required)

Returns:

- `reservationStatuses` (array of ElementReservationStatus or ErrorItem, required): One item per input element, in the same order.

Grasshopper: `GetReservationStatusOfElementsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetReservationStatusOfElements.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetReservationStatusOfElements.py): Gets the Teamwork reservation status of the first three walls with GetReservationStatusOfElements, without reserving them. Needs at least one Wall. In a solo project every element is editable.

### GrantElements

Hands over the reservation of elements to another Teamwork user, given by user id, without a dialog. Available from Archicad 27.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.3. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GrantElements

Parameters:

- `elements` (Elements, required)
- `userId` (number, required): The Teamwork user id of the user to hand the elements over to, as GetTeamworkProjectInfo, GetReservationStatusOfElements and the conflicts of ReserveElements report users.


Grasshopper: `GrantElementsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GrantElements.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GrantElements.py): Hands the reservation of the first wall over to another team member with GrantElements. Needs an open Teamwork project with at least one Wall and another member. The wall is reserved first, and stays reserved by the other member. Requires Archicad 27 or later.

### ReserveLockableObjectSet

Reserves a non-element lockable object set (attributes, favorites, project info, project preferences, etc.) in Teamwork mode. The object set is given by its Archicad API name, e.g. 'Composites', 'LayerSettingsDialog' or 'ProjectInfo'.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.1. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ReserveLockableObjectSet

Parameters:

- `objectSetName` (string, required): The name of the lockable object set, as the Archicad API documents it: BuildingMaterials, Cities, Composites, Favorites, FillTypes, LayerSettingsDialog (layers and layer combinations), LineTypes, MarkupStyles, MEPSystems, ModelViewOptions, OperationProfiles, PenTables, Profiles, ProjectInfo, GeoLocation (project location), PreferencesDialog (project preferences and dimension standards), GraphicOverrides (renovation override styles), Surfaces or ZoneCategories. Other names the Archicad API accepts work too.

Returns:

- `executionResult` (ExecutionResult, required)
- `conflicts` (array of User): The users whose reservation prevented reserving the object set.

Grasshopper: `ReserveLockableObjectSetComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/ReserveLockableObjectSet.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/ReserveLockableObjectSet.py): Reserves the Favorites of a Teamwork project with ReserveLockableObjectSet. Needs an open Teamwork project. Favorites that were free before are released again at the end.

### ReleaseLockableObjectSet

Releases a non-element lockable object set reserved with ReserveLockableObjectSet in Teamwork mode.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.1. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#ReleaseLockableObjectSet

Parameters:

- `objectSetName` (string, required): The name of the lockable object set, as the Archicad API documents it: BuildingMaterials, Cities, Composites, Favorites, FillTypes, LayerSettingsDialog (layers and layer combinations), LineTypes, MarkupStyles, MEPSystems, ModelViewOptions, OperationProfiles, PenTables, Profiles, ProjectInfo, GeoLocation (project location), PreferencesDialog (project preferences and dimension standards), GraphicOverrides (renovation override styles), Surfaces or ZoneCategories. Other names the Archicad API accepts work too.


Grasshopper: `ReleaseLockableObjectSetComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/ReleaseLockableObjectSet.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/ReleaseLockableObjectSet.py): Reserves the Composites of a Teamwork project and releases them again with ReleaseLockableObjectSet. Needs an open Teamwork project.

### GetLockableObjectSetStatus

Returns the Teamwork reservation status of a non-element lockable object set and the users who hold it.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.1. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetLockableObjectSetStatus

Parameters:

- `objectSetName` (string, required): The name of the lockable object set, as the Archicad API documents it: BuildingMaterials, Cities, Composites, Favorites, FillTypes, LayerSettingsDialog (layers and layer combinations), LineTypes, MarkupStyles, MEPSystems, ModelViewOptions, OperationProfiles, PenTables, Profiles, ProjectInfo, GeoLocation (project location), PreferencesDialog (project preferences and dimension standards), GraphicOverrides (renovation override styles), Surfaces or ZoneCategories. Other names the Archicad API accepts work too.

Returns:

- `status` (string ("Free", "Editable", "Locked", "NotAvailable", "NotExist"), required): Free: nobody has reserved it. Editable: the current user has reserved it. Locked: another user has reserved it (see conflicts). NotAvailable: the Teamwork server is offline or not available. NotExist: there is no Teamwork connection, for example the project is not a Teamwork project. An unknown object set name is reported as an error, not as a status.
- `conflicts` (array of User): The users who hold a reservation on the object set.

Grasshopper: `GetLockableObjectSetStatusComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetLockableObjectSetStatus.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetLockableObjectSetStatus.py): Gets the Teamwork reservation status of a few lockable object sets with GetLockableObjectSetStatus, and who holds them.

### GetTeamworkStatus

Returns whether the opened project is a Teamwork project and is online, the members of the shared project and who has reserved the Hotlink and XRef management. Works in a solo project too, then isShared and isOnline are false.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 1.7.3. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetTeamworkStatus

Parameters: none.

Returns:

- `isShared` (boolean, required): Whether the opened project is a Teamwork (BIMcloud) project.
- `isOnline` (boolean, required): Whether there is a live connection to the Teamwork server. Always false for a project that is not shared.
- `users` (array of TeamworkUser): The members of the shared project. Only present when the project is shared.
- `hotlinkCacheManagementOwner` (User): The user who has reserved the Hotlink and XRef management. Only present when somebody has reserved it.

Grasshopper: `GetTeamworkStatusComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetTeamworkStatus.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetTeamworkStatus.py): Gets with GetTeamworkStatus whether the project is shared and online, its members and who holds the Hotlink and XRef management. In a solo project isShared and isOnline are false.

### GetTeamworkOwnersOfDatabases

Returns the Teamwork owner (user id and name) of each given database, e.g. of a layout or a view database. The user id is 0 when nobody owns the database.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetTeamworkOwnersOfDatabases

Parameters:

- `databases` (Databases, required)

Returns:

- `owners` (array of User or ErrorItem, required): The Teamwork owner of each given database, in the order of the input. userId is 0 when nobody owns the database.

Grasshopper: `GetTeamworkOwnersOfDatabasesComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetTeamworkOwnersOfDatabases.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetTeamworkOwnersOfDatabases.py): Gets the Teamwork owner of the first three layouts with GetTeamworkOwnersOfDatabases. Needs at least one Layout. The user id is 0 when nobody owns the layout.

### UploadLibrariesToBIMcloud

Uploads local library folders or container files (.lcf) to a folder of a BIMcloud or Teamwork server, as BIMcloud libraries. Returns a result per library. Available from Archicad 29.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#UploadLibrariesToBIMcloud

Parameters:

- `libraryPaths` (array of string, required): The paths of the local library folders or container files (.lcf) to upload.
- `serverUrl` (string, required): The URL of the BIMcloud or Teamwork server, e.g. 'https://bimcloud.example.com:22000'.
- `parentPath` (string, required): The path of the folder on the server that holds the libraries, as shown in BIMcloud Manager.

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required): One result per library, in the order of the input.

Grasshopper: `UploadLibrariesToBIMcloudComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/UploadLibrariesToBIMcloud.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/UploadLibrariesToBIMcloud.py): Uploads a local library folder to a folder of a BIMcloud server with UploadLibrariesToBIMcloud. Set serverUrl, parentPath and libraryPath to your own server and library before running it; the values below are placeholders. Uploads to the server. Requires Archicad 29 or later.

### RemoveLibrariesFromBIMcloud

Removes libraries, given by name, from a folder of a BIMcloud or Teamwork server. Returns a result per library. Available from Archicad 29.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 1.8.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#RemoveLibrariesFromBIMcloud

Parameters:

- `libraryNames` (array of string, required): The names of the libraries on the server to remove.
- `serverUrl` (string, required): The URL of the BIMcloud or Teamwork server, e.g. 'https://bimcloud.example.com:22000'.
- `parentPath` (string, required): The path of the folder on the server that holds the libraries, as shown in BIMcloud Manager.

Returns:

- `executionResults` (ExecutionResults, required): One result per library, in the order of the input.

Grasshopper: `RemoveLibrariesFromBIMcloudComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/RemoveLibrariesFromBIMcloud.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/RemoveLibrariesFromBIMcloud.py): Removes a library from a folder of a BIMcloud server with RemoveLibrariesFromBIMcloud. Set serverUrl, parentPath and libraryName to your own server and library before running it; the values below are placeholders. Deletes the library from the server. Requires Archicad 29 or later.

### GetTeamworkRightsOfObjects

Returns for each given object, for example an element, whether the current Teamwork user has the right to create objects of its kind and to delete or modify it.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 2.0.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetTeamworkRightsOfObjects

Parameters:

- `objectIds` (array of GuidId, required): The objects to check, by guid, for example element guids.

Returns:

- `rights` (array of object or ErrorItem, required): One item per input object, in the same order.

Grasshopper: `GetTeamworkRightsOfObjectsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetTeamworkRightsOfObjects.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetTeamworkRightsOfObjects.py): Gets with GetTeamworkRightsOfObjects whether the current user may create, delete and modify the first three walls. Needs at least one Wall.

### GetTeamworkAccessRights

Returns whether the role of the current user has the given Teamwork access rights (API_TWAccessRights names without the API prefix, e.g. LayersCreate), all of them when no names are given.

Group: Teamwork Commands. Added in Tapir 2.0.0. Docs: https://archicad-api.com/archicad-addon/#GetTeamworkAccessRights

Parameters:

- `accessRights` (array of string): The names of the access rights to check, the API_TWAccessRights enumerators without the API prefix, e.g. LayersCreate or LibraryPartDeleteModify. All rights available in this Archicad version are checked when omitted.

Returns:

- `accessRights` (array of object, required): The rights of the current user, in the requested order.
  - `name` (string, required)
  - `hasRight` (boolean, required): Whether the role of the current user has this right.

Grasshopper: `GetTeamworkAccessRightsComponent`

Example: [archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetTeamworkAccessRights.py](https://github.com/ENZYME-APD/tapir-archicad-automation/blob/main/archicad-addon/Examples/Teamwork/GetTeamworkAccessRights.py): Gets with GetTeamworkAccessRights whether the role of the current user has a few Teamwork access rights. Without accessRights every right of the Archicad version is returned.

## Shared schema definitions

Types that parameters and results refer to by name.

### User

object
- `userId` (number, required)
- `userName` (string, required)

### Elements

array of ElementIdArrayItem: A list of elements.

### ElementIdArrayItem

object
- `elementId` (ElementId, required)

### ElementId

object: The identifier of an element.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### GuidId

object: Identifier.
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### Guid

string: A Globally Unique Identifier (or Universally Unique Identifier) in its string representation as defined in RFC 4122.

### Error

object: The details of an error.
- `code` (integer, required): The code of the error.
- `message` (string, required): The error message.

### ErrorItem

object
- `error` (Error, required)

### SuccessfulExecutionResult

object: The result of a successful execution.
- `success` (boolean (true), required)

### FailedExecutionResult

object: The result of a failed execution.
- `success` (boolean (false), required)
- `error` (Error, required)

### ExecutionResult

SuccessfulExecutionResult or FailedExecutionResult: The result of the execution.

### ExecutionResults

array of ExecutionResult: A list of execution results.

### Databases

array of DatabaseIdArrayItem: A list of Archicad databases.

### DatabaseIdArrayItem

object
- `databaseId` (DatabaseId, required)

### DatabaseId

object: The identifier of a database
- `guid` (Guid, required)

### TeamworkUser

object
- `userId` (number, required)
- `userName` (string, required): The login name of the user.
- `fullName` (string, required)
- `isConnected` (boolean, required): Whether the user has joined the project.

### ElementReservationStatus

object
- `status` (ElementReservationState, required)
- `reservedBy` (User): The user who has reserved the element. Left out when the element is free.
- `owner` (User): The Teamwork owner of the element. In Teamwork the owner is the user who has reserved the element, so this is the same user as reservedBy; kept for compatibility. Left out when the element is free.

### ElementReservationState

string ("Free", "Editable", "Locked"): Free: nobody has reserved the element. Editable: the current user has reserved it. Locked: another user has reserved it (see reservedBy).
